fields.title: PHASE 2 — 10-Year Milestones: Progress Scoring (29 items, first measurement)
fields.md:
Status definitions: `Unjudged` (not yet measured) / `In progress` (measured, judgment year not yet reached) / `Achieved` / `Achieved (early)` (met for **2 consecutive quarters** before the judgment year) / `Missed`. Early quarterly signals are placed under `In progress` (rule confirmed for this round).

**Axis A — Starlink** (Source: [8-K Ex.99.1 KPI](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066482/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm))

| id | Milestone | Current value → Target | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| A-2027-1 | Subscribers ≥20 million AND ARPU ≥$60 | 13.6 million / $69 | In progress |
| A-2028-1 | Subscribers ≥30 million, separately disclosed D2C revenue ≥$3 billion | 13.6 million / no separate disclosure | In progress |
| A-2029-1 | Connectivity annual revenue ≥$50 billion, operating margin ≥40% | Annualized $21 billion (= 5,248×4) / 45.1% | In progress |
| A-2030-1 | Subscribers ≥50 million, licenses in top 10 overseas markets | 13.6 million / operating in 174 markets (call) | In progress |
| A-2032-1 | Government/military revenue ≥$20 billion | Not measurable — only combined enterprise and government ($2.127 billion/quarter) disclosed | Unjudged |
| A-2036-1 | Connectivity annual revenue ≥$120 billion | Annualized $21 billion | In progress |

**Axis B — Starship** (Source: [Wikipedia Flight 14 overview](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starship_flight_14), [10-Q R27](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/R27.htm))

| id | Milestone | Current value → Target | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-2027-1 | Orbital insertion + Ship recovery ≥1 time | Orbital insertion 1 time (9/28) / Ship recovery 0 times | In progress |
| B-2027-2 | Annual flights ≥12 | 3 in 2026 (5/22·7/24·9/28) | In progress |
| B-2028-1 | Same Ship reflown ≥3 times | 0 times | In progress |
| B-2029-1 | Space R&D ÷ flights ≤$100 million/flight | $1.08 billion/flight (= 3,231 ÷ 3, 9M) | In progress |
| B-2030-1 | Annual flights ≥100 AND Space operating profit | 3 / 3Q operating income −$7M | In progress |
| B-2033-1 | Revenue recognition from commercial crewed lunar landing contract | Not measurable — only Starship lunar surface cargo contract awards disclosed | Unjudged |

**Axis C — AI** (Source: [8-K Ex.99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066482/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm), [10-Q R12](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/R12.htm))

| id | Milestone | Current value → Target | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| C-2027-1 | Nameplate ≥8GW AND AI annual revenue ≥$40 billion | 1.7GW / annualized $30.2 billion (= 7,560×4) | In progress |
| C-2027-2 | Annual revenue per GW ≥$15 billion | **$15.09 billion** (excluding Cursor) — met for 1 quarter, early signal | In progress |
| C-2028-1 | AI operating profit positive (annual) | 3Q +$431M — 1 quarter of profit, early signal | In progress |
| C-2029-1 | Top 2 customers' share ≤50% | **51.1%** (first consolidated disclosure) | In progress |
| C-2030-1 | Orbital data center revenue >$0 | $0 | In progress |
| C-2032-1 | AI annual revenue ≥$150 billion, operating margin ≥20% | Annualized $30.2 billion / 5.7% | In progress |

**Axis D — Financials** (Source: [8-K Ex.99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066482/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm), [10-Q R18](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/R18.htm))

| id | Milestone | Current value → Target | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-2027-1 | 2027 additional financing ≤$50 billion AND no equity raise | 2027 not yet reached. 2026 reference: total debt financing $51.8 billion, repayments $39.8 billion, reports of pursuing $40 billion, Cursor stock acquisition (not an equity raise) | Unjudged |
| D-2028-1 | Net debt/adjusted EBITDA ≤3.0x | Net cash $51 billion (ratio negative) | In progress |
| D-2029-1 | GAAP net income positive (annual) | 3Q +$4.404 billion / 9M −$413 million — early signal | In progress |
| D-2030-1 | Annual FCF positive | 3Q −$9.96 billion / 9M −$34.97 billion | In progress |
| D-2031-1 | Accumulated deficit begins to decrease | $41,852M → $37,448M (3Q decrease) — 1 quarter | In progress |
| D-2036-1 | Net debt ≤2x EBITDA AND share buybacks | Net cash / 3Q share buybacks 0 | In progress |

**Axis E — External** (Source: [NSF FAA 39A](https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/2026/01/faa-advances-approval-44-starship-launches-39a/), [Space.com collision avoidance](https://space.com/space-exploration/satellites/every-spacex-starlink-satellite-has-to-dodge-a-collision-almost-weekly-and-experts-fear-the-worst))

| id | Milestone | Current value → Target | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| E-2027-1 | FAA Starship annual permits ≥50 maintained | Per environmental approval: Starbase 25 + LC-39A 44 = 69/year (per-flight licenses separate) | In progress |
| E-2028-1 | Licenses in 5 overseas markets maintained | Not measurable — reports on India's final authorization conflict, other 4 countries unconfirmed | Unjudged |
| E-2027-2 | Collision avoidance ≤500,000/year AND loss ≤2% | 355,848 (2025-06 to 2026-05, sum of FCC semiannual reports) / loss rate not disclosed | In progress |
| E-2027-3 | Zero recurrences of involvement in disputes | 0 (observed this round) | In progress |
| E-2027-4 | New US federal contract awards ≥ prior year | Not measurable — 18 NSSL launches and 3 ISS crew awards confirmed, but amounts and prior-year comparison unavailable | Unjudged |

Scorecard (Source: the five axis tables above, `state.scorecard`): Achieved 0 · Achieved (early) 0 · Missed 0 · In progress 24 · Unjudged 5. Consecutive misses 0 — no forced recalculation condition.
